field.status: Obstacle stand-ins, mounting heights and exact placement are assumptions; official Q&A and measurement required.

training.action_space: Box(2): normalized forward speed and yaw-rate targets [-1,1]
training.observation_space: Box(18): pose/velocity, relative route target, lap/phase, tag/box, exchange, flag, timing and sensor summaries
training.reward: Dense progress and heading shaping plus task events; collision, timeout and unnecessary pit dwell penalties. Not an official score predictor.
training.randomization: Seeded assigned tag and explicit scenario options for start pose, obstacle, sensor noise, traction and exchange outcome; nominal evaluation disables noise and obstacles
training.evaluation: Held-out seeds not used for training; report task completion, contacts, time and score-like events separately
training.classical_baseline: Sampled forward/reverse/spin path follower with explicit mission phases and pit bail-out; no obstacle avoidance qualified
training.integration: Gymnasium-compatible Python environment; stable-baselines3 PPO optional, not a project dependency

limitations: Kinematic differential-drive plant with bounded acceleration; not the calibrated v9 motor/traction model.
Lap counting follows explicit route progress, not a referee ruling about pit-detour lap definitions.
Tire exchange is a timed stochastic event, not contact mechanics or a validated mechanism.
Tag and flag observations are synthetic; no camera or detector runs in this environment.
No trained policy or real-robot transfer is claimed until training and held-out evaluation artifacts exist.
Official Q&A may change legal corridors, flag behavior, parking and minimum-envelope interpretation.
